span.p:
Line styles
thick = main call path
thin = supporting path
dotted = not wired live,
unverified, or assistant-only
red dashed box = not in the code

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Words used
variable edge: fixed rule on a stored value
LLM edge: the model decides from what the caller says
speak node: fixed words. MCP: how the assistant calls tools
KV: key-value store. actor: one-at-a-time record keeper
